description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'html_select_time' that generates HTML dropdowns for selecting time components such as hours, minutes, seconds, and meridian (AM/PM). It includes plugin registration, parameter parsing, and HTML generation logic for a configurable time selection widget.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_select_time
methods.description: Generates HTML dropdowns for time selection, handling parameters for customizing appearance and behavior, and processes input to produce the appropriate HTML markup.
